title: Part Eighteen: Israel, Palestine and Gaza, 1994–2026

sections.brief: Holy See–Israel relations 1994–2026: 1997 Legal Personality Agreement; the economic/fiscal agreement promised in 1993, talks from 1999, last communiqué 2017, unsigned as of October 2026; visits of 2000, 2009, 2014; seven nuncios to Lingua (2026); frictions (2015 treaty, Gaza, Palm Sunday 2026) and cooperation (Herzog 2025, Good Friday call 2026). Figures: fig-time

Basic Agreement with the PLO dated 15 February 2000 from the text itself (15 January is an error); Jerusalem clause; 2012 UN vote; Comprehensive Agreement signed 26 June 2015, in force 2 January 2016; Israel's protest; Abbas visits 2014, 2017, 2025; Leo XIV and Parolin on two states to September 2026. Figures: fig-compare (three treaties)

Gaza 2023–2026 statement by statement with Israeli replies: Francis's calls to the Holy Family parish, 'terrorism' (22 Nov and 17 Dec 2023), the 17 Nov 2024 book remark on investigating genocide, 'cruelty' (21 Dec 2024); Parolin Feb 2024 and 6 Oct 2025 ('inhuman and indefensible' = the 7 October attack; corrects Book 7); July 2025 church strike and Netanyahu's call; Leo XIV to August 2026; Pizzaballa. Figures: fig-time

Why words but no rupture: Lateran Art. 24 and FA Art. 11 quoted; practice (Berlin to 1945, Damascus, Nicaragua 2022–23, Ireland 2011 the exception); named critics on both sides; the Holy See's stated position; labelled 'loud silence' lens. Figures: fig-compare
